finding.title: Ryeong's own phrasing largely does not route to search in production
finding.detail: '제갈민씨 찾아줘' routes to DialogueAct.OTHER and executes no tool, while '제갈민씨 명함 찾아줘' routes to CONTACT_SEARCH and returns a ranking. Ryeong's questions are mostly of the first shape ('{name}씨 회사가 어디야?'), so the official run should be expected to exclude or fail many routing turns. This is a contract gap between the two systems, not an adapter defect, and the canary deliberately uses production-compatible phrasing so that a plumbing check does not double as a routing score.
finding.must_not_be_used_as: a reason to tune production or to rewrite the frozen scenarios
